description: This source file defines the LocaleUtility class, which provides utility methods for working with Locale objects within the OpenMRS project. It includes functions to retrieve the default locale, compare locales for compatibility, create locales from string specifications, obtain ordered collections of locales, and handle global property changes related to locale settings.

classes.name: LocaleUtility
classes.description: A utility class for working with Locales, including fetching the default locale, comparing locales, creating locales from specifications, and managing locale-related global properties within the OpenMRS system.

methods.name: getDefaultLocale
methods.description: Retrieves the default locale configured as a global property, caching the result for efficiency.

methods.name: areCompatible
methods.description: Determines if two locales are compatible based on language and country specifications.

methods.name: fromSpecification
methods.description: Creates a Locale object from a string specification, handling various formats.

methods.name: generateLocaleFromLegacyFormat
methods.description: Helper method to create a Locale from legacy underscore-separated string format.

methods.name: getLocalesInOrder
methods.description: Returns a set of locales including the current user locale, default locale, allowed locales, and English, in a predictable order with no duplicates.

methods.name: setLocalesAllowedListCache
methods.description: Sets the cached list of allowed locales.

methods.name: globalPropertyChanged
methods.description: Resets locale caches when a global property related to locale changes.

methods.name: globalPropertyDeleted
methods.description: Resets locale caches when a relevant global property is deleted.

methods.name: supportsPropertyName
methods.description: Checks if the property name is one that the LocaleUtility listens to for changes.

methods.name: isValid
methods.description: Validates if a Locale object has available ISO3 language and country codes.
